name: workerd DBG first-chance kj dump
description: Runs locally-built debug workerd under procdump and dumps on first kj::ExceptionImpl.
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $bin=Split-Path '${WorkerdPath}'; $w=Join-Path $bin 'workerd-dbg.exe'; $probe='${ProbeCapnp}'; $diag='${DiagDir}'; $dumps="$diag\dumps"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dumps | Out-Null; $procdump = Join-Path $bin 'procdump.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $w)) { Write-Error "debug workerd not found: $w"; exit 2 }; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $bin 'workerd-dbg.pdb'))) { Write-Error "debug pdb not found next to exe"; exit 3 }; if (-not (Test-Path $procdump)) { Write-Error "procdump not found: $procdump"; exit 4 }; if (-not (Test-Path $probe)) { Write-Error "probe capnp missing: $probe"; exit 5 }; Write-Output "workerd: $w"; Write-Output "pdb    : $(Join-Path $bin 'workerd-dbg.pdb')"; Write-Output "probe  : $probe"; Write-Output "dumps  : $dumps"; & $procdump -accepteula -ma -e 1 -f 'ExceptionImpl@kj' -n 1 -x $dumps $w serve $probe 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Output '== resulting dumps =='; Get-ChildItem $dumps -File -Filter 'workerd-dbg*.dmp' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 FullName, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
